Description
This is Volume 15 of the classic martial arts manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy), written and illustrated by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也).
This Traditional Chinese edition was officially licensed and published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan.
Featuring Egawa’s iconic art and humor, this volume continues the energetic adventures of Kotaro, blending martial arts action and slapstick comedy. Includes a short author bio section with a photo of the creator inside.
